page.overview:
Who is Gamatama?

Due to not having the combat ability to yet form a contract with shinobi, Gamatama is entrusted as a name-registration clerk on Mount Myōboku.

Gamatama has a very small body. He has black irides with yellow sclerae. Gamatama also has pink skin covering the upper half of his body while his underside is white. As a tadpole, he still has a tail.

Gamatama was seen watching over the list of inhabitants of Mount Myōboku. When he noticed that Kōsuke was no longer on the list of inhabitants, he surmised that he was deceased and proceeds to inform Fukasaku about his demise.
